subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted vs Dedicated — latency/throughput follow-up

Hi Alex —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery: FinPay is evaluating where to run real-time scoring for anti-fraud (text + embeddings) across peak hours. You mentioned two hard constraints we should solve for:

- P95 inference latency under 200ms for short text scoring (<= 256 tokens)
- Sustained throughput of ~5k requests/min during peak windows, with spikes to 8k+ for 30–45 minutes

From a deployment perspective we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to ship, transparent pricing, good for bursty but can see variability in tail latency during noisy neighbors
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools with predictable throughput and lower p95 tail — fits cases with strict latency and sustained throughput needs
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for regulated data — looks unnecessary for FinPay today unless procurement requires it

Attached is a short comparison PDF and the traffic sample CSV you shared during the call (renamed for our thread).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the traffic sample above (or point me to the exact QPS profile).
2) If the numbers are accurate, we schedule a short perf test on Dedicated with Neha running load against a representative model (we can do a one-week reserved trial).
3) We align on decision criteria (latency SLO, cost target, rollout date).

Are you available for a 30-min perf review Thurs or Fri this week? If it helps, Neha can prepare a preliminary perf run plan and expected cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood-hosted-vs-dedicated-comparison.pdf, finpay-traffic-sample.csv

Thanks Marissa — appreciated the recap. Correct on the numbers:

- P95 target <= 200ms for scoring (most requests are 32–128 tokens)
- Sustained: 5k req/min (~83 req/sec) during business hours, with 30–45m spikes up to 8k (~133 req/sec).

A few clarifications:
- We expect roughly 60% of calls to be embedding+score flows (so slightly heavier).
- Cost is important but SLA on latency for customer-facing pages is non-negotiable.
- Procurement will want a committed price for Dedicated if we go that route; otherwise Hosted with SLA credits could work but we'll need tighter tail guarantees.

We can do Thurs 3pm PT for the perf review. Please include Neha and any SRE who runs the perf tests. Also, can you send an outline of what the Dedicated trial looks like (duration, metrics you’ll measure, and what artifacts we’ll get)?
